MISC. No.59595 of 2023(4) dt.18-12-2023 bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned court below where the case is pending/Successor Court in connection with Bela P.S. 8.

If the petitioners have not deposited the said amount, then there bail bond shall not be accepted.
